name: unknown-outcome-stripped
description: an unrecognised RUN_FINISHED outcome member is stripped from its optional position with a warning, leaving the run to end exactly as an outcome-less RUN_FINISHED does
kill: make stripAgainst return the value instead of DROP for an unmatched discriminated-union member — the run then fails validation. eventTypes and eventAbsentPaths together are what pin the shape of the tolerance: a client that warned and dropped the whole terminal event would otherwise pass, since a stream ending without a terminal is not itself rejected

dotnet.intentional: the .NET outcome converter is a closed union, so an unrecognised discriminator is a fatal JsonException rather than stripped material: the run fails and only RUN_STARTED is ever delivered, which is why neither the surviving terminal nor the stripped path can be asserted here. `errorContains` pins the converter's own message — without the trailing `Path:`/`LineNumber:` detail System.Text.Json appends — so this lane fails for THIS reason and not for any other rejection
